policy.lineage: same source feed, repeated snapshot, derived feed, same provider/generator with transferable structure-specific adaptation, or explicit operator-specific adaptation can leak between development and holdout.
policy.not_automatically_leakage: GTFS standards, generic IDs, physical shared stops, and territorially interacting routes do not establish lineage.
policy.system_context: TDL currently evaluates deterministic rules, not a model trained on examples. Holdout protects against rules designed after inspecting all feeds, operator-specific exceptions, known-dataset heuristics, and false generalization.
